description: Check an active monitor's page now instead of waiting for its schedule. The check runs in monity.ai's cloud browser and takes up to a minute or two; then get_latest_result shows it. Counts against the plan like any check. Resume a paused monitor first. For a dataset (a uuid from list_datasets) it collects every page again: that takes a few minutes and spends the plan's check credits (1 for each page it visits, 5 more for each page read with AI, 2 a minute for a saved login); if it cannot start, the answer says why (for example, not enough credits). Read the result with get_dataset_rows or get_dataset_changes.
name: run_monitor
title: Run a check now
